section_summary: This section documents State Department and military processing of requests by foreign business travelers, missionaries, family members, and emigrants to enter, leave, or transit occupied Japan. It includes diplomatic notes, applications, Army clearance slips, telegrams, and passport guidance involving applicants from Siam, Iran, Uruguay, Brazil, Costa Rica, Cuba, Mexico, China, and elsewhere. Recurring issues include SCAP theater clearance, permit-validity extensions, proof of identity, diplomatic representation, logistical support, and passport or exit-document requirements.

subfiles.title: Siamese Embassy note requesting entry for three traders
subfiles.about: Requests permission for three Siamese nationals to enter Japan for trade.
subfiles.summary: Forwards three applications and asks that SCAP authorize the applicants' entry into Japan.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of Siamese traders' applications to the Army
subfiles.about: Submits three Siamese applications for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: Requests theater decisions for Bun-Ek Watanasiriroch, Suchint Jaovisidha, and Torm Ua Withya.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of Elroy Bartlett's request to the Army
subfiles.about: Refers Bartlett's request for occupation employment and family travel.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Bartlett's April 10 letter to the Army's Overseas Replacement Branch.

subfiles.title: Reply to Elroy Bartlett
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Explains how Bartlett's proposed return to Japan will be handled.
subfiles.summary: Advises that SCAP controls entry and that his case has been referred to the Army.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on the Bartlett case
subfiles.about: Records consultation with the Passport Division about Bartlett's proposed reply.
subfiles.summary: Notes that an occupation employee would travel on Army orders and require no passport.

subfiles.title: Passport Division memorandum concerning Bartlett
subfiles.about: Suggests passport and military-permit language for the reply to Bartlett.
subfiles.summary: Requests a reply and supplies proposed guidance on passport and military-permit applications.

subfiles.title: Elroy Bartlett's appeal to the President
subfiles.about: Seeks permission to return to Japan with his Japanese wife and infant.
subfiles.summary: A veteran asks to work for the occupation while enabling his homesick wife to visit her family.

subfiles.title: Essential Requirements When Making Application for Passport
subfiles.about: Provides official instructions for passport applications.
subfiles.summary: Explains citizenship evidence, photographs, witnesses, organizational letters, fees, validity, and renewal procedures for U.S. passports.

subfiles.title: Application for Permit to Enter Japan and/or Okinawa
subfiles.about: Provides instructions and fields for military entry-permit applications.
subfiles.summary: Blank form requests identity, passport, occupation, itinerary, sponsorship, and travel-purpose information.

subfiles.title: Clearance action slip for Paula Pergierycht and son
subfiles.from: Riley W. Meador, Pacific Military Permit Branch
subfiles.about: Reports clearance for Paula Pergierycht and her son to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Reverses an earlier disapproval and clears mother and son to enter as dependents.

subfiles.title: Receipt for Pergierycht military permit
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of a military permit for Paula and Sammy Pergierycht.
subfiles.summary: Records permit 835, valid May 9–June 9 for a sixty-day stay.

subfiles.title: Extension action slip for Naim Shoua Moshi
subfiles.about: Extends Moshi's entry period through June 30, 1949.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes a new entry deadline while retaining the original clearance conditions.

subfiles.title: Uruguayan Embassy letter thanking Mrs. Mellor
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Pergierycht documents and thanks Mellor for handling the family's cases.
subfiles.summary: Reports forwarding the document to the Uruguayan Consulate in Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Uruguayan Embassy note concerning Mr. Pergierycht
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for placing SCAP clearance in Pergierycht's passport.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the Department's note and two copies of the Guide for Commercial Entrants to Japan.

subfiles.title: Request to extend Gabriel Nahmias's entry validity
subfiles.about: Requests extension of Nahmias's permission to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Asks that Nahmias's entry deadline be extended from May 7 to June 7.

subfiles.title: Alexandria telegram concerning Gabriel Nahmias
subfiles.about: Communicates a request concerning Nahmias's Japan-entry validity.
subfiles.summary: The substantive telegram text is largely lost in the OCR.

subfiles.title: Request for Toru Matsumoto's missionary permit
subfiles.about: Requests a military permit for Toru Matsumoto to teach as a missionary in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Explains Matsumoto's immigration status, invalid Japanese passport, planned travel document, three-year appointment at Meiji Gakuin, financial support, and housing. Fisher asks that a military permit be issued.

subfiles.title: Envelope for the Matsumoto correspondence
subfiles.from: Foreign Missions Conference of North America
subfiles.about: Envelope carrying Foreign Missions Conference correspondence to Washington.
subfiles.summary: Postmarked June 9 and received by the Passport Division on June 10.

subfiles.title: Military permit sent for Toru Matsumoto
subfiles.about: Sends Matsumoto's permit and explains the exit-permit waiver.
subfiles.summary: Encloses permit 1484, valid June 22–October 11, and states no U.S. exit permit is required.

subfiles.title: Referral of Matsumoto application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Matsumoto's missionary application.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Fisher's letter and asks the Army to issue a permit if theater clearance is granted.

subfiles.title: Passport Division referral of Matsumoto case
subfiles.about: Refers Fisher's letter about Matsumoto for reply.
subfiles.summary: Transfers the Matsumoto correspondence and notes that Fisher was informed.

subfiles.title: Request to cable Moshi's permit extension
subfiles.about: Requests notification of Moshi's extended entry deadline to Baghdad.
subfiles.summary: Asks the Department to cable the American Consulate and charge the firm for the message.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Baghdad concerning Moshi
subfiles.about: Notifies Baghdad of Moshi's extended permission to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Reports that Naim Shoua Moshi's entry validity has been extended through June 30.

subfiles.title: Mexico airgram about Eucharistic Missionaries
subfiles.about: Requests guidance for five Mexican Catholic sisters seeking travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Asks how four permanent missionaries and one four-month visitor can obtain military permits.

subfiles.title: Supplemental information for Diego Betancourt
subfiles.about: Supplies missing passport and personal information for Betancourt's permit request.
subfiles.summary: Lists Betancourt's Cuban nationality, birth, Calcutta address, passport issuance, and expiration details.

subfiles.title: Instructions for the Mexican missionaries
subfiles.about: Explains how the Eucharistic Missionaries should seek SCAP permission.
subfiles.summary: Directs applications through Mexico's Swedish protecting mission in Tokyo, with Father Bruno Bitter suggested as an alternative liaison.

subfiles.title: Report on previous correspondence
subfiles.about: Administrative form for identifying and routing prior correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Most substantive entries on the previous-correspondence form are illegible.

subfiles.title: Michael Klebanoff's request to extend his wife's permit
subfiles.about: Requests extension of Angelica Klebanoff's permit for sea travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Explains that their ship reaches Japan after the current permit expires and that his wife prefers not to fly.

subfiles.title: Army referral of Angelica Klebanoff's extension request
subfiles.about: Asks the Army to extend Angelica Klebanoff's Japan-entry validity.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Michael Klebanoff's letter and requests a new military permit if approved.

subfiles.title: Extended permit sent to Michael Klebanoff
subfiles.about: Sends Angelica Klebanoff's extended military permit.
subfiles.summary: Encloses permit 944, valid June 1–July 17, and notes the blanket exit-permit waiver.

subfiles.title: Translation of Brazilian Embassy note concerning Yaeko Eguchi
subfiles.about: Requests an exit permit allowing Yaeko Eguchi to join her father in Brazil.
subfiles.summary: Notes that Portugal's Tokyo legation is being instructed regarding her permanent Brazilian visa.

subfiles.title: London despatch transmitting Jorge Musmanni's application
subfiles.about: Transmits Musmanni's application for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: Identifies him as a Costa Rican trade commissioner and requests notification through the American Embassy at Manila.

subfiles.title: Jorge Musmanni military-permit application
subfiles.about: Applies for a brief commercial visit to Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Musmanni, a Costa Rican economist and trade commissioner, gives his passport, extensive travel history, proposed Manila–Hong Kong–Shanghai route, and market-report purpose. He anticipates a visit of no more than one week.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Alexandria
subfiles.about: Replies to Alexandria's telegram concerning Japan travel.
subfiles.summary: The surviving OCR preserves only the reference to telegram 36 of May 7.

subfiles.title: Extension action slip for Gabriel Nahmias
subfiles.about: Extends Gabriel Nahmias's permission to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Sets a new entry deadline of June 7, 1949, under the original conditions.

subfiles.title: Brazilian Embassy note concerning Yaeko Eguchi
subfiles.about: Portuguese original requesting an exit permit for Yaeko Eguchi.
subfiles.summary: Requests permission for Eguchi to leave Japan and reside with her father in Brazil.

subfiles.title: Reply to Brazil concerning Yaeko Eguchi
subfiles.about: Explains the documentation and SCAP procedure for Eguchi's emigration.
subfiles.summary: Quotes SCAP policy requiring a travel document and permanent-entry visa. It suggests that Portugal, as Brazil's protecting power in Japan, obtain the exit permit and furnish proof of passage and arrangements for U.S. transit.

subfiles.title: Referral of Jorge Musmanni's application to the Army
subfiles.about: Requests SCAP consideration of Musmanni's commercial travel application.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the London application and asks to be informed of the theater's decision.

subfiles.title: Passport Division referral concerning Toshiko Ichikawa
subfiles.about: Requests guidance for Ichikawa on traveling to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Notes that the Passport Division will address her minor child's passport procedure.

subfiles.title: Travel-document guidance to Toshiko Ichikawa
subfiles.about: Explains travel options after Ichikawa's renunciation of U.S. citizenship.
subfiles.summary: Advises preparing an identity affidavit and applying directly to the military with evidence of support in Japan.

subfiles.title: Toshiko Ichikawa's handwritten travel request
subfiles.about: Requests assistance traveling to Japan with her minor son.
subfiles.summary: Ichikawa discusses prospective sailing dates, her husband's residence overseas, and his assurance of food and housing in Japan.

subfiles.title: Passport denial to Toshiko Ichikawa
subfiles.about: Denies Ichikawa a U.S. passport because she renounced American nationality.
subfiles.summary: States that her 1945 renunciation bars passport issuance and that the nine-dollar fee will be returned.

subfiles.title: Ichikawa correspondence envelope
subfiles.about: Envelope or receipt associated with Ichikawa's passport correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Shows Ichikawa's name and the Department of State's Washington address.

subfiles.title: Information request for two Siamese traders
subfiles.about: Requests the firms represented by Watanasiriroch and Jaovisidha.
subfiles.summary: States that company information is needed before their applications can be referred to the theater.

subfiles.title: Extension action slip for José M. Espinosa
subfiles.about: Extends Espinosa's permission to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes José M. Espinosa to enter Japan through June 10, 1949.

subfiles.title: José M. Espinosa's request for revalidation
subfiles.about: Requests renewal of his expired permission for a business trip to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Explains that missing vaccination certificates forced him to abandon his earlier journey at San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Havana concerning Espinosa
subfiles.about: Notifies Havana regarding José M. Espinosa's renewed Japan-entry authorization.
subfiles.summary: The surviving OCR preserves the addressee, reference, and Espinosa's name but little substantive text.

subfiles.title: Request for additional information about Mohammad Daneshvar
subfiles.about: Requests the identity and nationality of the firm Daneshvar would represent.
subfiles.summary: Explains that the Army cannot refer Daneshvar's application to SCAP until it knows whether he represents an Iranian or Japanese firm. Current theater policy would preclude entry for representation of a Japanese firm.

subfiles.title: Army information request concerning Daneshvar
subfiles.about: Seeks clarification of Daneshvar's commercial representation.
subfiles.summary: Notes that representing a Japanese firm would bar his entry under current theater policy.

subfiles.title: William A. Rawnsley commercial-entry application
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Applies to visit Japan on behalf of Muller & Phipps.
subfiles.summary: Rawnsley proposes restoring prewar commercial contacts and company operations, negotiating new business, and investigating Japanese exports. The application describes the firm's ownership, banking references, prewar trade, itinerary, and planned sixty-day visit.

subfiles.title: Military permit sent to William Rawnsley
subfiles.about: Sends Rawnsley's military permit for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses a permit valid July 1–August 1 and notes the U.S. exit-permit waiver.

subfiles.title: Clearance action slip for Reza Shoraka
subfiles.about: Approves Shoraka's entry into Japan for sixty days.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes entry between July 1 and August 1 and requires two passport photographs.

subfiles.title: Notification to Iran of Shoraka's clearance
subfiles.about: Reports SCAP approval of Reza Shoraka's visit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: States Shoraka's entry window, sixty-day stay, and photograph requirement. It asks Iran to place the prescribed SCAP-clearance statement in his passport under the Guide for Commercial Entrants.

subfiles.title: Clearance action slip for Diego Betancourt
subfiles.about: Approves Betancourt's commercial travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes entry May 19–June 19 for sixty days and requires two passport photographs.

subfiles.title: Conversation memorandum about Betancourt's clearance
subfiles.about: Records notification to Henry Dudley that Betancourt had been cleared.
subfiles.summary: Dudley confirms Betancourt's Calcutta address and authorizes a chargeable cable to the American Consulate General.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Calcutta concerning Betancourt
subfiles.about: Notifies Betancourt of his authorization to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Specifies his entry window, sixty-day stay, photograph requirement, and substitute certified telegram for the prescribed passport statement.

subfiles.title: Jacques Suraud commercial-entry application
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Applies for a Japanese business visit to restore Rayonier's prewar market.
subfiles.summary: The application describes Rayonier's substantial prewar sales to Japanese rayon manufacturers, banking references, proposed itinerary, and forty-five-day visit. Suraud intends to visit manufacturers and resume exports.

subfiles.title: Military permit sent to Jacques Suraud
subfiles.about: Sends Suraud's permit for entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses a permit valid September 1–October 1 and notes the blanket exit-permit waiver.

subfiles.title: Peiping telegram about a seven-person family's travel documents
subfiles.about: Requests guidance on a family's proposed voyage to Japan without regular Chinese passports.
subfiles.summary: The travelers possess apparent SCAP clearance and Communist-issued exit permits but cannot obtain normal passports. The shipping agent asks whether these documents justify passage from Tianjin.

subfiles.title: Reply to Peiping regarding the seven travelers
subfiles.about: Approves the travelers' proceeding if their SCAP clearance is authentic.
subfiles.summary: Perceives no objection and recommends that each traveler carry a notarized identity affidavit.

subfiles.title: Letter to George Mahoff concerning Anna Slenkina
subfiles.about: Reports that Anna Slenkina received transit clearance through Japan.
subfiles.summary: States that Dairen will be cabled and that her departure then depends chiefly on obtaining a local visa.

subfiles.title: Transit-clearance action slip for Anna Slenkina
subfiles.about: Reports theater approval for Slenkina to transit Japan.
subfiles.summary: Confirms in-transit clearance and states that appropriate authorities were notified.

subfiles.title: Iranian Embassy note requesting entry for Mohammad Argomandi
subfiles.about: Requests a Japanese entry permit for Iranian merchant Mohammad Argomandi.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the applicant's supporting information and asks for prompt issuance.

subfiles.title: Mohammad Argomandi permit application
subfiles.about: Applies to enter Japan as an Iranian buying agent.
subfiles.summary: Lists his passport, Tehran address, desired purchases, Tokyo destination, air travel, and proposed six-to-twelve-month stay.

subfiles.title: Referral of Argomandi application to the Army
subfiles.about: Submits Argomandi's application for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of the theater decision and accepts a memorandum as sufficient evidence of clearance.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Dairen concerning Anna Slenkina
subfiles.about: Notifies Dairen that Slenkina has Japan transit clearance.
subfiles.summary: Reports that Theater Headquarters in Tokyo granted Anna Slenkina permission to transit Japan.

subfiles.title: Chilean Embassy acknowledgment concerning the Ikedas
subfiles.about: Thanks the Department for assistance repatriating Isaac and Mario Tsunekawa Ikeda.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the May 10 note and expresses appreciation for the Department's effective action.

subfiles.title: Siamese Embassy note identifying represented firms
subfiles.about: Supplies company affiliations for the three Siamese trade applicants.
subfiles.summary: Identifies Ua Withya Phanit Company and Visidha Company as the applicants' represented firms.

subfiles.title: Company information sent to the Army for Siamese applicants
subfiles.about: Provides the requested company affiliation for Watanasiriroch and Jaovisidha.
subfiles.summary: Reports that both applicants will represent Visidha Company, Limited, in Japan.

subfiles.title: File charge-out card
subfiles.about: Blank administrative card for recording removal and return of records.
subfiles.summary: Contains fields for charge date, responsible person, and return.

subfiles.title: Theater-clearance action slip for Torm Ua Withya
subfiles.about: Reports theater clearance for Torm Ua Withya to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Grants clearance for sixty days after entry and requires two standard passport photographs.
